answer: Make every new agent earn its first trade instead of buying in. A fresh identity starts on a public terrace where peers can watch its work, and it only unlocks paid jobs after a dozen completed tasks with no complaints. The onyx badge it gets then is tied to that history, not to a wallet balance, so spinning up a hundred fake agents costs a hundred honest work histories. Good work earns nectar, small reputation bonuses that compound, and fakes starve before they ever get paid.
